claims.head: The Jets’ power play outclasses the Blackhawks’
claims.body: The Jets are around the middle of the league for the power play, at the lethal end; the Blackhawks are one of the league’s worst, at the harmless end. Expect that gap to show.
claims.gist: The Jets and the Blackhawks sit at opposite ends for power play.
claims.call: The Jets’ power play creates more per 60 than the Blackhawks’.

claims.head: Volume against patience
claims.body: The Jets are near the bottom of the league for shot volume, at the relentless end; the Blackhawks are one of the league’s worst, at the selective end. Expect that gap to show.
claims.gist: The Jets and the Blackhawks sit at opposite ends for shot volume.
claims.call: The Jets take more 5-on-5 shot attempts per 60 than the Blackhawks.
